items.text: Hello everyone, today A Little to the Left is releasing for the Nintendo Switch 2! As we were doing some house cleaning to get everything in order for that release, we took some time to fix up some lingering issues across all platforms.

notes.title: Here's the full list of updates included in v3.7.3

items.text: Reviewed all hints for accuracy game-wide, and made the following updates:
Main Game
Tacks - added colour and corrected number of berries.
Spoons: Stacked Solution - Corrected the position of center.
Spice Jars: Level Solution - Corrected the level line so it matches the artwork.
Fruit stickers: Remove All Stickers Solution - corrected the number of stickers that should be removed from fruit.
Cat food cans - Corrected order of cans.
Boxes Side: Arrows Solution - updated arrows with colour and added missing arrow.
Wet paw prints - Added paw print.
Spider (colour assist) - Added center yellow bug.
Telescope - Updated with Star highlight and added hints per constellation phase.
Lamp - Updated number of lights in hint.
Tupperware Tower - Added colourblind mode hint.
DLC1
Media Cabinet - Added hint to Gameboy.
Fish tackle box - added missing stripes to fishing lures.
Coins Shape 01 - Corrected the shape of coins in hint.
Boss - Pre hint - added three more hints that show added keys to drawer.
DLC2
Curtains - updated hint to match art in level, highlighting the pattern where the curtain overlaps.
Boss Compass Phase 3 - swapped compass so chain matches artwork in level.
Archive
Something Eggstra - broken eggs hint - swapped first two eggs to match level art.
Added artwork to engage the black bars in the letterbox margins that lock the playable area to 16:9 aspect ratio

No longer possible to exit the Daily Tidy menu early when completing a Daily Tidy puzzle, before various award animations can run. This could lead to a scenario where the streak bonus stars would not be awarded until next Daily Tidy puzzle completion, as the animation was cancelled due to the early close of the menu
Fixed an issue where game would softlock if the Star Tutorial tooltip was accessed from the Level Select from within the Pause menu during gameplay before tutorial had been seen through natural play
Leaves will no longer regrow in mid-air if plucking in rapid succession in the Daily Tidy Trim Plant puzzle
Leaves in Daily Tidy Trim Plant will no longer spawn in with different visually sorting from that of their symmetrical counterpart
Lower branches will no longer disappear when zooming in the Daily Tidy Trim Plant, if puzzle was generated with a short pot
Close button will no longer trigger through the eraser if eraser is visually obstructing it in the Hint Menu
Closing the Resolutions dropdown in the Settings Menu via clicking outside of the dropdown list window will no longer block Quick Select from triggering
DLC2 Water Glasses can no longer be solved with ice cubes outside of the glasses
DLC2 Robots will no longer let Robots snap to placement position if in the incorrect transformation for the solution, which could lead to sorting inconsistencies
Coins in the main campaign Coins puzzle now exhibit collisions, to avoid a scenario where a coin can appear to clip through other coins that are visually stacked atop in the incorrect stacking order
Daily Tidy Books puzzle will no longer load-in pre-solved state for symmetry solutions leading to auto-solve
Daily Tidy Telescope will no longer generate with placeable stars located just outside the visible play area
Wet Paw Prints level no longer transitions in from the bottom of the screen on “Reset”
Prints will no longer appear above the cloth in Phase 2 of Wet Paw Prints if the cloth was dropped through an obstructing leaf
Objects can no longer be bumped out of placement position if another object is dropped onto it
Tweaked positioning of targets for better position detection of the Red and Grey Batteries in the Batteries level
Pen in the DLC2 Materials Drawers will no longer snap to position behind the drawer
DLC2 Markers hints for “Lines” and “Shape” solutions updated to use same hint for both regular and colourblind versions, as these versions provide more detail
DLC2 Balls hint for “Section Count” solution corrected to reflect 11 sections for the Soccer Ball, instead of 12
DLC2 Whistles hints for “Value” and “Rings” solution updated to represent actual colour of item, instead of greyscale value
365 Daily Tidy puzzle completed celebration indicator text now matches the boldness of other badge text
Restored Tupperware tower background elements on mobile device
Quickly resetting a level after petting the cat in DLC1 Cat Moments will no longer result in a softlock condition
Overloading the shelves in DLC2 Bookshelf can no longer result in a scenario where too many books can start to squeeze into a compartment

Objects in DLC2 Junk Drawer Transforming are no longer able to be placed into positions for different solutions if those positions occupy the same compartment, as this could lead to inconsistent sorting if those objects overlap visually
Blades in the Neat Streak Paper Plane Supplies level are no longer able to be pushed out of the visible play area if placed at the top edge of the screen
Daily Tidy Books will no longer generate blue/green colour combo when “Colour Assist” mode is active
Merry Mess Crackers Toy Train puzzle car-to-car detection improved, and cars won’t disconnect with quick movements of the train engine
Books in the Mirror puzzle now reliably solve if the 2nd Book from the bottom is the last to be interacted with
Books in the Mirror puzzle can no longer solve with misalignment in the stack
Increase press time for button to confirm save data deletion. No longer gets stuck if triggered very quickly.
Jar Lid in the Medicine Cabinet level will no longer get stuck on vertical surfaces or at the screen edges
Stickers placed at the top or bottom edges of the Fruits in the Fruit Stickers puzzle will no longer teleport to the opposite side when rotating
Hint eraser will no longer appear outside of the 16x9 frame if dragged to the edges of the playable area
Improved solve reliability in Tacks puzzle
Updated the Lamp sprite in the Lamp puzzle to remove an extra dot
Pasta in Pasta puzzle no longer exhibit continuous jitter if stuck on eachother
Labels in the Settings menu and Daily Tidy badges will no longer wrap oddly for long words
Fixed softlock that could occur if Colour Assist modal is closed immediately upon presentation on level complete
Fixed softlock that could occur in Seeing Stars Star Finale level if control method changes whilst grabbing the Star held by the Cat Paw
Hi all!
We were so happy to see the recently announced Steam Achievement Sets! This is a huge improvement and something we’ve been asking for for years.

We implemented this straight away, and we’re so relieved that achievement hunters out there no longer need to worry about the DLC achievements impacting their ability to get 100% unlock for A Little to the Left.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40696875/d3b7e93b5b498bf815dbdf7572a0890e2c821b25.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40696875/e1a2f855d791eff38b69cfcd793cf5e4b0e97247.png"]

You can see the new achievement groups on your internet browser here, but for the groups to appear in your Steam Client, Steam Deck or Steam Machine you'll need to enable the Steam Client Beta as detailed on this page: https://help.steampowered.com/en/faqs/view/276C-85A0-C531-AFA3

This is a big upgrade to the Steam achievement system in general. If you want to read about everything that just released, you can learn more here: [dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/group/4145017/view/677385962174549063"]
-Max Inferno Team

Hi everyone, we released an update v3.6.1 late last week, and incase you were wondering what it's about, it is a hotfix patch that is intended to mitigate cases of save data corruption that could occur on Windows machines.

Essentially, this hotfix enforces save files to be encoded as UTF-8, instead of letting Windows infer the encoding type; there were rare cases where Windows could incorrectly interpret the save file as a legacy encoding type (ANSI), leading to the data becoming corrupted as it was read in the wrong format.

We are monitoring for issues related to this fix, and so far so good! If you do encounter a corrupted save file, please don't hesitate to reach out to us at support@maxinferno.com with details as to how the corruption occurred, and we'll look into it. Thanks!

Hi all, you may have noticed a new update available for A Little to the Left version 3.6.0 and were wondering what it's all about! We've continued to provide bugfixes to some rare issues that had come to our attention. Here's the list of fixes:
Fixed rare freeze that could occur on Daily Tidy Trim Plant level generation
No longer possible for Daily Tidy Books level to solve if books are paired from shortest to tallest or thinnest to widest when symmetrical height or width solutions are in play
Stacked objects grabbed as they are dropping will no longer miss detection of stacks below
Tape roll in Workbench level placement detection is now more reliable
Level Select levels track edge scroll will now continue to push if using mouse input, and cursor is out of bounds but still within window (such as in cases of ultrawide screens)
Wipes dropped on the kit handle in DLC2 First Aid Kit can no longer disappear
Stamps will no longer jump through envelopes or get stuck to the edge of another envelope partially obstructing a valid placement area in the Stamps puzzle (both base game and Daily Tidy version)
Fixed a soft-lock in the Stamps puzzle that could occur when rapidly clicking stamps and envelope
Telescope Daily Tidy will now spawn larger placeable stars and will no longer spawn stars atop predefined constellation stars, to make them easier to see
Soup Cans puzzle solution made more forgiving
Hint pages will no longer get stuck between states if page is flipped while menu is closing
Updated hints for symmetry levels in base game (Shells, Seed Pods, Clovers) for clarity, to communicate both puzzle rules and an example solution layout
Updated font in controller diagrams for consistency
Corrected placement positions of DLC2 Markers for visual consistency
Vibration is now deactivated on any connected controllers by default, if the primary control method does not support vibration
(Steam Only) Verify temporary save data is complete and valid before copying over to save path, to protect from save data corruption

(ARM Only) Resolved an issue that saw render textures such as cleanable surfaces or dynamic scribbles (Post-it Note Daily Tidy) persisting onscreen as static black patches, due to a rendering bug in the compatibility layer in machines with ARM-based processors
As always, thanks so much for playing!

Hi everyone, we had a small number of issues that popped up as part of some of our changes introduced in the Packed Update. Not too many fixes here, but a few critical ones, most notably around some Daily Tidy tweaks that produced confusing or unsolvable puzzles.
Fixed errors that were preventing the Daily Tidy Plant puzzle from solving in some variations
Eased difficulty of the Daily Tidy Calendar puzzle redesign by removing multiple cadences, and improving hint
Fixed issue in Daily Tidy Books that saw puzzle start in order, causing puzzle to auto-solve and making it unable to be solved the alternate way

Added an accessibility fallback to the Cat Pet rhythm segment of the Radial Dance Party that if after 1 minute the pet timing criteria has not been met, but more than 8 pets have been attempted, any subsequent pets will be considered successful
Persist and load local backup save data in the case that cloud save operation corrupts save file
Preventing excessive error logging from ZoomManager appearing in log files if save data cannot be loaded
Slow music effect from Sharp Pencils cat swipe will no longer persist into next level in Shuffle mode, or if level was exited to Title via the Retry menu and gameplay was re-entered from there
No longer possible for the Curved Zip Tie and Bit Case to be lost offscreen in the Archive Tool Drawer level
Nail in upper left corner of screen in Parts Organizer puzzle will no longer shift position when level has transitioned in

Removed additional criteria from Colour Assist version of Cupboards & Drawers DLC Coin Box level that required columns for Colour solution to be in a specific row order based on segments count. Columns can now be in any order, to align with logic found in the main game version
Eased required alignment for bottom right Paint Can for Label solution in Paint Cans puzzle
Fixed inconsistent title sizes on Level Selects for “Home Sweet Home” in Polish and “Good Tidyings” in Simplified Chinese
Resolved superficial crash that could occur when quitting the game on Steam by using the “Quit” button on the Title Menu
As always, thanks so much for playing!
Hello everyone,

Almost three years since it first launched, our cozy puzzler A Little to the Left is wrapping up. Today’s Packed Update neatly brings active development on the game to an end, with one final gift to you, the fans, to thank you for your love and support over the years.
3 new drawer-themed Archive puzzles
Revised hints throughout the game that highlight solution criteria
Daily Tidy Streak UI to help visualize streak status
Ease DT streak requirements (checkpoints, bonus stars, missed day grace period)
Add incentives to continue DT play beyond all badges earned
New alt badges awarded at increased badge tiers
Badge Selector perk when exceeding 365 completions
Add 1 new DT puzzle (Books)
Minor gameplay revisions in some existing DT’s
Hints for Daily Tidy puzzles to help inform on mechanics
Colour Assist Mode (adjusts puzzles that rely on colours for their solutions)
Tutorials explaining role of stars and new streak UI
Ability to disable Quick Select (especially useful for those on Switch experiencing JoyCon drift)
Adding zoom/pan functionalities from mobile to all other platforms
Open menu with right-click (for one hand play)
Keyboard/mouse support for Xbox/PS
Shuffle mode
Save data backups to restore corrupted save files
In-game link to newsletter signup on Steam
Bug fixes

This little house was one of the main inspirations for our little game, and both have changed our lives in a big way. It’s a fitting coincidence that we are moving on from our lovely little home at the same time as we are releasing the final update to our dear debut game, A Little to the Left.
We have cherished the feeling that we have connected with and welcomed so many players through our game. Thanks for playing, and for letting us know that you found something special in what we made.
This isn’t really goodbye, as we still have lots of ideas for things to make, and lots of energy to make them. So wish us luck, stay in touch, and we hope to meet again in our future projects.
Annie, Lukas & Rookie the cat

notes.title: Full changelog for The Packed Update v3.5.8

items.text: Content

notes.title: 3 New FREE drawer-themed puzzles in the Archive

items.text: Bathroom Drawer
Tool Drawer
Paper Plane Supplies
New Daily Tidy puzzle: Books
Microscope Daily Tidy game design updated to reduce from three rounds of shape matching, to a single round, but with the addition of decoy shapes added to the field
Calendar Daily Tidy now has more variety of stickers offered and solution patterns
Features and Gameplay

New “Shuffle” gameplay mode: Available from the Title screen after the main campaign is completed, “Shuffle Mode” will remix all available levels (campaign, Archive, and owned DLC’s) in a new surprising order, different every time!
Added Streak UI to the Daily Tidy menu, along with easing of streak requirements:
Streak tracker that visually communicates current and longest streak counts
Added a grace period to streak criteria, accepting one day to be missed without resetting streak
Implemented checkpoints aligned with achievement thresholds (at 7, 14, and 30 days) that allow for broken streaks to pick up from last achieved threshold
Streak completion (30 days) now awards 10 bonus stars toward Daily Tidy total!
Crossing a Daily Tidy badge threshold when all badges are already earned (100+ completions), will now award a choice to replace current badge at tier with a new randomly awarded badge

Daily Tidy completion count of over a year (365+ completions) now grants access to the Badge Selector widget, allowing players to freely select any combination of badges to be able to craft their ideal set
Daily Tidy puzzles are now supported by in-game Hints
Added celebration effects to Daily Tidy menu for each year of play (multiple of 365 completions)
Added a Tutorial to explain the role of stars. Will present on first multiple solution level completion, or can be accessed from question mark icon next to stars count on Level Select menus

Loose objects will now detect and be automatically added into vacated placement of slots within range if occupying object has been removed. This helps resolve scenarios where level doesn't properly trigger solve, even through it appears objects are correctly positioned, as they had not been explicitly seated into position

Updated hints throughout to highlight solution logic (Batteries, Books 1, Calendar, Cat Food Cans, Cat Frame, Cleaning Supplies, Clock, Clover, Computer, Drink Glasses, Eggs, Fridge Inside, Fridge Postcards, Junk Drawer, Medicine Cabinet, Plant Pots, Seed Pods, Shells, DLC1 Jewelry Box, DLC1 Junk Drawer X2, DLC2 Markers)
To prevent save data corruption, save operation now writes data to a temporary file and moves it to save path on successful write instead of directly writing data to main save file
Right mouse button now opens the Pause Menu during gameplay, to accommodate mouse-only play
Unlock sequence on Level Selects can be skipped by pressing Start/ESC/Right mouse button
Level Progress Reset confirm button now requires a long press, to minimize accidental reset of progress
Hint Menu can now be navigated with swipe gestures
Seeing Stars Boss Drawer can now be resumed across multiple play sessions (if not fully completed prior)
Added a Max Inferno newsletter signup popup to the Daily Tidy menu
Accessibility
Added Colour Assist mode, a toggleable setting found in the Settings menu, to help players with colour-perception difficulties navigate colour-based puzzles:
A modal will appear the first time encountering a puzzle with Colour Assist support (if the setting is not already active), that explains the feature and allows for the preference to be set

Several puzzles have been updated to provide alternate visuals that bypass colour criteria entirely, such as Books 3, Coloured Pencils, Tacks, Pencils 3, Matchboxes, Paint Cans, Spice Jars, Stacked Boxes, Storage Boxes, Rock Gradient, Desktop Computer, Tupperware Tower, Good Tidyings Cookies, Good Tidyings Stacked Presents, Something Eggstra Egg Cups, Something Eggstra Painted Eggs, Cupboards & Drawers Coin Box, Cupboards & Drawers Filing Cabinet, Seeing Stars Cupcakes, Seeing Stars Markers

Other puzzles have seen minor visual updates in the core experience to help with colour differentiation, such as the addition of shape or texture. Base levels that have been altered are Junk Drawer, Gems, Spiderweb (including Daily Tidy version), Cupboards & Drawers Craft Supplies, Cupboards & Drawers Fountain Pens, Seeing Stars Bookshelf, Seeing Stars Figurines

Buttons puzzle has been redesigned to provide a secondary visual characteristic to help avoid the need to perceive colour. The derived Sorting Items Daily Tidy puzzle has also been updated to solely focus on buttons objects and will no longer provide a random set of tinted objects to sort. Both versions of this puzzle now have a new second solution criteria to accommodate the accessibility changes

Added Zoom function to be able to enlarge game play, to aide legibility of visual detail, as well as help ease interaction with small objects. Moving held objects to the edge of a zoomed view will push the visible frame in the desired direction. Clicking and dragging on an unoccupied part of the screen will pan the zoomed frame. Zoom is activated via the mouse wheel, controller shoulder buttons (L & R), or +/- keys on the keyboard
Added diagram for touch controls to Settings menu
Added “Quick Select” toggle to the Settings menu
Added controller diagram for Steam Deck
(Consoles only) Added Zoom enabled toggle to the Settings
(PC only) Added VSync toggle to the Setting
Bugfixes
Eraser visual in Hints menu will no become misaligned with cursor for some odd viewports/resolutions
Drawer in the Gems Jigsaw level no longer reacts as if grabbable
Cursor pointer behaviour is now consistent while modals are active
Orange stem in Fruit Stickers level no longer appears behind orange
Telescope Daily Tidy no longer renders an unplaceable Star in some rare permutations if placeable star spawns within two target placement areas on start
Options will now deactivate in the Settings Menu if they are not supported by the active control method

Level Select will no longer back out to Chapter 1 intro when closing if the Level Select had been exited to due to progression being halted by a level with a minimum star requirement that was not yet unlocked (such as the bonus levels of Seeing Stars DLC)
Quick Select now works in Spiderweb level
Sourced more adequate fallback fonts for Polish language special characters found in menus
DLC2 Markers no longer solves with mismatched pairing and ordering criteria if Lid is placed last
Hint Hunter achievement now increments with each hint revealed, instead of only counting one hint per level
Stickers in the Calendar puzzle now support Quick Select and Cursor Assist
Silent error no longer thrown when quitting the game while playing the Clock level
Gems puzzle “Faces” solution now accepts reverse order

Orange Breadtag in DLC1 Kitchen Utensils level will no longer become non-interactive if located at the lower edge of the green drawer while objects are quickly moved between drawers using touch controls
Menu close “X” buttons now hide when a modal is active
Added star icon beside completion percentages in Level Select to provide context
Pencils will no longer pop out of placement position if another pencil is incorrectly placed
Microscope Daily Tidy now avoids rendering two similar outer-ring shapes which could make match ambiguous
Cursor will no longer remain in grabbed state when solving Microscope level by use of scroll-wheel zoom feature when Tap to Hold is active
Microscope level mouse-scroll zoom reversed (up = in, down = out)
Microscope level inside lens push scroll areas width reduced to avoid accidental push when moving cursor to top or bottom edge of zoom ring
Trim Plant Daily Tidy level now generates with much more consistent distribution across the plant
Incorrectly plucked leaves can no longer respawn behind static leaves in the Trim Plant Daily Tidy level
Resolved issue that could prevent objects that passively enter a placement location via physics to snap
Interactive stickers in the Calendar puzzle (and Daily Tidy version) now have a thin shadow to indicate that they are interactable, to be visually differentiated from immovable guide stickers
Smaller stickers will appear above larger stickers in the Calendar puzzle (and Daily Tidy version), with guide stickers always appearing behind interactive ones
Removed the spider from the Spiderweb level icon, to limit exposure (spider still appears on solve of puzzle)
Placing Green Match in Purple Box now produces fully Blue Match
Updated Mushrooms to Cauliflower in Seeing Stars Leftovers level, as Mushrooms are not a vegetable and could confusing as how to be classified
Corrected error in hint for Seeing Stars Stacked Books spine solution
Updated Pump Bottle visual to remove red cross symbol in Seeing Stars First Aid Kit puzzle

Sumo Group and Sumo Digital removed from game credits as affiliation is no longer
Blocks placed in the edge columns of TupperwareTower will no longer snap back into tower if removed by perfectly horizontal drag action
Background objects no longer appear in front of the tower in TupperwareTower
TupperwareTower blocks will no longer be able to be left with tilt if tapped while tower is shaking
No longer able to interact with loose blocks that were placed above a completed line in the moment between ascension transition and auto-falling blocks in TupperwareTower
Cat no longer appears in front of held loose blocks in the TupperwareTower

Added a fallback for rare occurrence where a level was solved without unlocking the next on the Level Select. Game will now auto-unlock next level on Level Select if previous level has completion data
Cats ornaments in Cupboards & Drawers Nested Boxes level will no longer become non-interactive if experience collisions that push from the inside to the outside of the cabinet
Slowed down music effect from Record Player level will no longer persist into the Pause Menu if Sharp Pencils level was completed, then another level was selected via Level Select in the Retry Menu

Completing the Wet Paw Prints level with Tap To Hold active will now auto-release the held cloth

Cupboards & Drawers Junk Drawer puzzle will no longer allow solve by stacking stamps
Earplugs in the Cupboards & Drawers Junk Drawer puzzle now enforces earplugs to be placed in alternating orientation as indicated by the notches in their compartment

Fixed game wide issue where objects placed in front of an occupied placement position and the previously occupying object was removed from behind, the object could appear to be in placement position, but not registered as such
Black Tack in the Tacks level will no longer become stuck if moved quickly between the middle targets
Stars in the Telescope Daily Tidy will no longer start in a placement position
Telescope Daily Tidy will no longer repeat the same constellation
Telescope Daily Tidy icon updated to be able to appear on white part of the Daily Tidy icon effect
Effective cleaning area of cloth in the Wilted Flowers level now scales will resolution
Middle stem in the Trim Plant Daily Tidy will now render symmetrical static leaves, to avoid confusion
Improved fit in the Batteries Daily Tidy
Fixed sort inconsistencies in the Cupboards & Drawers Pantry level, where items in the narrow lower shelves could appear in front of objects on the floor

Overlap detection of symmetry objects in the Shells, Seed Pods, Clover, and Symmetry Daily Tidy is now more reliable and will indicate invalid overlap state when snapping
Stamps in the Stamps puzzle (and Daily Tidy) will no longer experience placement false negatives if other Stamps are placed upon an Envelope that’s overlapping

releases.displayName: A Little to the Left 'Packed' Update Arrives June 26 - Our Final Update!

items.text: Hey everybody,
We’ve seen that you have been asking about what to expect from A Little to the Left this Summer, and we’re pleased to finally tell you about the free Packed Update, coming June 26th!

We’re introducing new levels, modes and improvements, all neatly packaged into our final major update. It launches later this week on PC, Mac, Switch, Xbox and PlayStation, and mobile versions will also receive the free update very soon.

[img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXeKJ1x2QJQHCM5dF9aCTMHaSgU6ST8qkz2cz75Y1zCsIWnwOwg8t3QPkgPTX800a62VscTQeo_r4YR32xi2oWm4uIVrivUbG9bp8Co8A0oI7RzW8NemFiJkqBnML03iAaznlWP8?key=DJonUkNyNO5RUdpA1SpLlg"]
3 new drawer levels.
1 new Daily Tidy.
Daily Tidy streak tracker.
Daily Tidy hints.
Colour Assist Mode.
Shuffle mode.
Zooming and panning.
Improved Performance.
New badge selector.
Our last big update.

This will indeed be the final update for A Little to the Left, as we move onto new gaming adventures. We will share more thoughts in a post on June 26th, but for now, we want to thank the wonderful ALttL community for your support over the past three years. We hope you enjoy this final package of features and fun.

releases.displayName: A new update is on the way!

items.text: Hey everyone,

In case you missed the reveal during the Games With Wings Showcase, we just confirmed a free update is coming to A Little to the Left later this year, and amongst other things it'll feature three new levels.
auspiciously crumpled toothpaste tube
off-season glow-in-the-dark vampire teeth
perfectly normal flat head screwdriver
seemingly misplaced ice cream cone
Plus many more everyday items.
Well done to everyone who guessed new levels were incoming from our previous teaser!
It's still early days for this update and as we're aiming to support many different platforms (including mobile!) simultaneously we don't yet have a time frame locked in.
Our best estimate for now is mid-year, but we'll share more about the planned date and the update's other features when we can.
Annie, Lukas & Rookie the cat

Hello everyone, you may have noticed that there have been a couple of updates released on Steam within the past month: v3.1.0 and v3.1.4. These updates are focused on fixing bugs introduced from the Seeing Stars patch that were causing some friction or inconsistencies. We still have more to look at (there always is), but this covers a good chunk.

Fixed an issue where clicking on objects in the DLC2 Boss while the drawer was closing would cause the Gems phase to be skipped, going straight to the next objects puzzle phase, leading to a blocker state where the level would not trigger completion upon solving all three objects puzzle phases
Picked up Gems in the DLC2 Boss will no longer appear behind other Gems
The Heart Robot in DLC2 Robots level could have Hearts placed down near its knees if the Robot had not first had its state changed, now Hearts can only be placed in the open chest cavity.
Hearts container for Heart Robot in DLC2 Robots level can no longer become misaligned if the Robot was moved partially offscreen while the chest cavity was open.

Objects are now unable to be picked up while a drawer is transitioning state. This behaviour could lead to a condition where objects could become stuck in a partially non-interactive state and unable detect targets.
Objects can no longer be pulled out of a closed drawer if very close to the edge (such as in the DLC2 Materials Drawer level), which could lead to objects becoming lost out of play.
When holding an object, drawer in DLC2 Combs level now only automatically opens on handle hover
Selecting the “Play” button on the Title Screen will now resume play from last unlocked level (or last played level if New Game+) when main Campaign is selected.
Boxes will no longer become non-interactive in the DLC1 Nested Boxes level if set down loose within the cabinet, and another Box is placed into its target placement location atop of it.
Improved action when clicking the toggle buttons in the Lamp level when Tap to Hold setting is active.
Hacky Sack in the DLC2 Balls level now reliably collapses when hitting the floor, and will no longer become inadvertently rotated if had collided with another ball.
Objects in the Buttons level, and associated sorting Daily Tidy level, now exhibit shadows.
Radial Dance Party will now progress more reliably from Cat Toys and Soup Cans phases
Improved compatibility of Quick Select functions in Radial Dance Party
Cacti in DLC2 Cacti level can no longer get stuck floating in the air
DLC2 Cacti level will no longer solve for height solution if the Cacti are in correct order, but two pots are reversed
It is no longer possible to clear the paw prints through the newspapers or rug in the first phase of the Wet Paw Prints level
The bottom right plant leaf in second phase of the Wet Paw Prints level will no longer become non-interactive if clicked immediately when the phase objects become interactable
Cursor will no longer highlight paw prints as interactive in the Wet Paw Prints level
Fixed layering issues with the newspaper and rug in the Wet Paw Prints level
Prints left by the cat in the third phase of the Wet Paw Prints level can no longer land out of bounds
Increased collision accuracy for the paw swipe in third phase of the Wet Paw Prints level
Improved performance of cleaning cloths in the Wet Paw Prints, Wilted Flowers, and Dirty Coins levels
Cursor will no longer remain holding Coins in the Dirty Coins level when Tap To Hold is active
Steam Achievements now unlock properly if internet connection is lost while in Online Mode
Foods will no longer fidget after being placed in the Tupperware Nesting level
Accordion handles will no longer disappear when placing the Accordion in the DLC2 Music Box level

Stacked objects in the Fridge and Mirror levels now properly detect solve condition when were aligned or passively moved outside of final placement position, then passively moved into placement by way of interaction from an object lower in the stack
Corrected hints for the Archive Something Eggstra Painted Eggs solutions
Corrected hint for the DLC2 Forks “Ornaments” solution
Added detail of interaction points on the Compass and retractable Protractor in DLC2 Math Set hints
Increased the size of the interaction point on the retractable Protractor in DLC2 Math Set to be a bit more obvious, and updated level icon to match
Icons on the computer in the Desktop Computer level will now detect placement if another previously occupying icon is moved out of the way
Art for double-barrelled and banded Whistles in the DLC2 Whistles puzzle updated for clarity
Hints for DLC2 Whistles level updated to clarity
Background removed in DLC2 Whistles level to reduce visual noise
Restored missing collision SFX for Whistles in DLC2 Whistles level
Changed the Cucumbers to Celery in DLC2 Leftovers level to avoid confusion whether cucumber should be classified as fruit or vegetable
DLC2 Leftovers column-oriented solutions now allow gaps between columns
Corrected the “Levels” solution in DLC2 Leftovers to enforce order of least-to-most contents (or vice-versa) across the crosswise axis, as intended by design
“Keeping Count” and “Top Heavy Slice” achievements are now achievable if the level was Reset
Removed position of Toy Music Box handle from solution criteria for the DLC2 Music Box puzzle as it was too obscure
Reduced the number of allowable slide positions for the Slide Whistle in DLC2 Music Box
Alignment has been made more forgiving for the “Labels” solution in DLC2 Ink Bottles level
DLC2 Markers “Colour” solution now accepts green markers to be swapped to accommodate order by scientific value in addition to perceptive hue
Improved compatibility of Quick Select functions in DLC2 Markers level
“Jigsaw” solution in DLC2 Water Glasses now accepts Ice Cubes in any configuration regardless of if they’ve been rotated to achieve fit
Ice Cubes in DLC2 Water Glasses will no longer become stuck on each other
No longer possible to solve the DLC2 Transforming Junk Drawer with both the Ticket Stubs and Telescope in the right-most compartment
Ticket Stubs and Envelopes now stack with offset in DLC2 Transforming Junk Drawer
Credits scroll will no longer freeze if the app was unfocused for the duration of the credits song
Solving second solution for Daily Tidy Pencils in forward and reverse orders no longer counts as separate solutions
Objects in the Pasta and Pretzels levels will no longer exhibit tilt if they have been picked up and dropped without moving
Telescope Daily Tidy no longer render an unplaceable Star in some rare permutations
Boxes will no longer become non-interactive if sitting loose within the Main Box, and 2 nested boxes are placed in their solution position overtop the loose box
Quick Select point will no longer become misaligned on the Rug in the 1st phase of the Wet Paw Prints level
DLC2 Music Box level will no longer abruptly solve while interacting with Slide Whistle if position of slide is last element to be placed
DLC2 Music Box level will no longer solve if the Comb is in extended state
Extended Comb will no longer appear behind Tuning Forks when placed in DLC2 Music Box
Removed collisions from Slide Whistle slide in DLC2 Music Box
Slide Whistle slide visual will no longer separate (or briefly disappear) from body visual if object is moved while slide is easing into position in the DLC2 Music Box level
Improved stability in DLC1 Lunch Tray level. Objects within trays no longer exhibit collisions with loose objects outside of tray
Hint for “Weapons” solution has been corrected in Merry Mess Nutcrackers level
Hint for “Knees” solution has been updated to feature a highlight in Merry Mess Nutcrackers level
Celery now snap into placement in DLC1 Lunch Tray level
Envelopes will no longer jitter if placed to the left or right of open drawer in Junk Drawer Transforming level
(Steam only issue) “Tabs” solution now reliably awards a star in DLC2 Leftovers level
Previous/next page buttons are now Quick Selectable in the Hint menu
Please note that these updates are currently only available for Steam at this time, but will be coming to all other platforms soon!
Thank you so much for your patience, and for your help to locate bugs! As always, please keep reporting bugs as you come across them!

Details
Upgraded A Little to the Left to use Unity's 2021 LTS version, which resolves issues with the game ignoring inputs while in a 'windowed' state on macOS Sonoma.
As always, thank you so much to all of you who have left feedback or reported bugs.

Tomorrow is an exciting day for us, as we're also launching on Xbox Series X|S, PlayStation 5, and PlayStation 4. Please help us spread the word and welcome more players into the world of A Little to the Left.
Hey everyone!

We bring you news from the back of the pantry; we've uncovered some new food-themed puzzles for you to feast upon. These three new Snack Pack levels come as part of the Deep Clean update which is now live! The update also adds three new puzzle types into the Daily Tidy mode, the fan-requested Archive mode as well as a number of improvements and bug fixes.

The Archive mode grants all players permanent access to previous limited-time seasonal puzzles, including the Good Tidying pack from December 2022 and the Something Eggstra pack from April 2023. All future seasonal puzzles will also be added into the Archive.

Finally, the Deep Clean update brushes away rogue clumps of coding cobwebs and design dust bunnies for an even smoother overall tidying experience. You will find the patch notes for this update hidden below.
[expand type=details]
The "Archive": a new section available to all players that allows for limited-time holiday-themed event puzzles to be played any time, available from the Title screen.
The "Snack Pack": introducing 3 brand new hand-crafted "snack"-themed levels, available to play in the Archive.
3 new Daily Tidy puzzle types: Stamps, Pencils, and Post-it Notes
Microscope with improved navigation added back into Daily Tidy schedule

Redesigned "Retry Menu" allows for pause on puzzle completion to take in solution, with option for immediate retry, proceed to next puzzle, or access to full pause menu (enabled by default, can be deactivated in the Settings).
Microscope level improved navigation
Eased acceptable placements throughout
"Play" button on the Title screen will now enter the previously active level of the current menu theme (campaign or Cupboards & Drawers DLC)
Stars are no longer awarded for Cat petting interludes in the Cupboards & Drawers DLC
Added Cursor Assist to help when selecting objects or menu items when using a controller
Added toggle to disable "Wiggle Effect" for those who experience photosensitivity or motion sickness
Added failsafes that prevent system configurations that could result in jittery/shaky cursor behaviour
Systems set to use Saudi Arabia UmAlQuraCalendar will no longer fail to boot on subsequent launches
Stacked Boxes "Tape" or Good Tidyings Presents puzzle solutions can no longer be solved with a space between the boxes
Microscope scroll field no longer interactive when clicking outside of the lens area
Microscope zoom direction is now consistent when rotating zoom dial from left or right side of lens
Change to drag SFX clip in Microscope level
Foods in Tupperware Nesting will no longer shift on transition in
Plant leaves will remain interactive if grabbed and released without being plucked
Matches in Matchboxes level will no longer appear behind scattered matches while being held after being taken out of a matchbox
Quick Select no longer targets invisible stickers in the Fruit Stickers level
DLC will no longer be automatically added to Cart when visiting the DLC Store page from the in-game DLC call-to-action modal
Removed invisible grab point in Stacked Papers level
Bowls "crack" solution detection reliability improvements
Frames no longer rotate different directions based on grab position in Frame Maze
Can no longer Quick Select while holding an object
Resolved crash that could occur when resetting level immediately after petting the cat in the Radial Dance Party intro
DLC Sewing Box level hint now shows 5 buttons in each set, and added second hole to large black button sprite
DLC Jewelry Box level now accepts Rings in reverse order
Objects can no longer disappear in the Place Setting level if clicked while the cat is pulling
Cat will now resume its grab cycle if all grab points were previously obscured in Place Setting level
Small pot in DLC Pantry no longer hops on the floor
Cupcakes now position properly when Cake Stand is dropped on top in DLC Pantry level
Strawberries in the Plate level are a little less squishy sounding
Added some minor signposting to DLC Game Pieces and DLC Hanging Kitchen Utensils 2

Sorted Items Daily Tidy puzzle will no longer generate variations including objects that are too large to fit into the tray, colours that are too similar, or provide two indiscernible sets with the same Button sprite
Wing Nut and Bent Nails can now be properly Quick Selected in Sorted Items Daily Tidy puzzle
Fixed issue that could cause Daggers in DLC Daggers level to sometimes become unresponsive
Bottom left cupboard in the DLC Trophies level can now close with the Mug Trophy inside
Cars in DLC Boss Drawer can no longer get pushed out of play
Spice Jars Daily Tidy will no longer render a set with two colours that are too difficult to discern
Cupboard objects now play drop SFX when no snap occurs
Play button will no longer return to Credits if that was the last played level
Improved navigation of Resolution dropdown when using a controller
Increased size of hitbox on small crumbs in Tupperware Nesting level
"Levels" option is no longer available in the Pause menu when playing a Daily Tidy puzzle, as it would incorrectly lead to campaign Level Select
Exacting Eggs achievement will no longer unlock if more than 2 moves have been performed
A Balanced Meal and Where Is My Cap? Achievements can now be achieved after a level reset
The free new update is available now for PC, Mac and Nintendo Switch players.
We hope you enjoy this new update, and we truly appreciate your love and support for our little game.
Annie, Lukas & Rookie the cat

Today (April 5th) saw the release of the latest patches for both the PC (1.2.2) and Nintendo Switch (1.2.1) versions of A Little to the Left. The full details of which are below.
Thank you again to everyone that has left feedback or reported bugs; we really appreciate it!
Addition of “The Something Eggstra” Easter event. Four hand-crafted egg-themed levels running for the span of four days between April 7th to 10th.
Daily Tidy

Reduced the ability for Daily Tidy puzzles to repeat in quick cycle.
Reduced sensitivity of swap for objects in fixed grid puzzles (such as the Rocks Gradient puzzle).

Hello folks! Here we are at the 3 month anniversary of the release of A Little to the Left, and we’ve been blown away by the response! So many of you have shared your gameplay experience with us, and this has helped us understand what’s working, what needs improvement, and what you’d like to see more of… Thank you all for sharing with us!

One of the topics of discussion has surrounded the Daily Tidy and Steam Achievements. With help from your feedback, our patch v1.1.9 has made some changes that we hope will make the Daily Tidy and Steam Achievements more accommodating.
Daily Tidy

We’re reducing the number of solutions required to be awarded the top 3 Daily Tidy badge tiers, so more players can enjoy them- a full year for top rank was far too much! As a result, the completion count for the 90 puzzles solved badge will reduce to 50, the 180 tier will become 75, and the 365 will now be 100.

notes.title: A full list of Daily Tidy updates includes

items.text: Reducing number of solutions required for the Daily Tidy top-tier badges from 90/180/365 to 50/75/100
"Spice Jars" Daily Tidy will no longer produce variations where both solutions have the same order, which was resulting in the second solution not being detected
Objects can no longer blend into the background in "Symmetry" Daily Tidy levels
Removed the variation of the "Symmetry" Daily Tidy that featured the bread tags sprites, as it was confusing with the “Bread Tags” puzzle
"Spider Web" Daily Tidy will no longer produce variations with overlapping fly placements
Achievements

We have decided to keep only Achievements that can be unlocked at any time, during any play through, so that all players can strive for them. This means that the following achievements will be removed, as they are tied to limited-time events and not currently unlockable:
Special Day
Complete a Daily Tidy special event
Special 5
Complete 5 Daily Tidy special events
Special 10
Complete 10 Daily Tidy special events
Special 15
Complete 15 Daily Tidy special events

notes.title: Other Achievements will see their requirements reduced

items.text: Almost A Hundred Halfway There
Complete 90 50 Daily Tidy's
Turnaround Tidier Three-quarter Sorter
Complete 180 75 Daily Tidy's
Hint Hunter
Reveal every 10 hints
What Is Will Be
Skip every 10 levels with “Let it Be”

notes.title: A full list of Achievements changes includes

items.text: Removal of the “Complete X Daily Tidy special events” Achievements
Adjustment to the counts required for the “Complete X Daily Tidy’s” Achievements, to align with the modified badges scaling mentioned in the section above
Reduction of the “Hint Hunter” and “What Is Will Be” Achievements from requiring “every” to only requiring 10 hints and skips
"Helpful Hints" achievement now operational (if you are having trouble with this, please see this forum post)
"No Mess Left Behind" achievement stability fixes
"Fun For Humans" achievement stability fix
"Be The Chaos" achievement difficulty reduced
Additionally, we are aware that some of you have had your Daily Tidy streaks stalled recently. We are currently investigating and hope to be able to include a fix in our next update.
Other
Added OpenGL 3.3 support for legacy Mac's (pre-2014)
Thank you all for your patience and kind support, and for providing us with your feedback. We will continue to listen to feedback and are committed to improving the A Little to the Left we all love.

Well, it's been a busy 1.5 months since launch and the response has been absolutely wonderful for A Little to the Left! It's been a joy to watch players connect with the game, and we really appreciate everyone who has reached out with feedback and bug reports. Thank you!!
Features
Implementation of the "Good Tidyings" limited-time Daily Tidy holiday event, featuring 6 new free holiday-themed puzzles releasing one per day, over the span of 6 days from December 22nd to 27th.
Achievements & Data
Modals for outputting data save/load errors
"Streak Resolver" to repair streaks that were broken due to getting an unsolvable variation of the Bread Tags or Spice Jars Daily Tidy's
Hint Hunter and What is Will Be achievements stability fix and now supports unlock on subsequent playthroughs
Campaign achievements now award at end of credits or if credits are aborted, instead of awarding as final level completes
Reset on Eggs level no longer negates Exacting Eggs achievement
Exacting Eggs and Keep Away achievements no longer awarded on level skip
No longer able to trigger the "consecutive Daily Tidy's played" achievements through uninstall/reinstall of game
Daily Tidy-related achievements descriptions now indicate that puzzles must be completed, not just played in order to qualify for achievement
Added indicator to Hint menu for when a hint has been adequately revealed to qualify for hint-related achievements
Stats reset count when starting a new game save (this won't affect existing awarded achievements)
Gameplay
Added interaction feedback to freeform Symmetry puzzles (Shells, Seed Pods, Clovers) to better communicate puzzle criteria
Updated hints on freeform Symmetry puzzles (Shells, Seed Pods, Clovers) to communicate puzzle logic rules instead of showing singular solution
Updated artwork for improved player feedback in Front of Fridge: Postcards, Workbench, and Lamp levels
Goal height reduced by 33% in Tupperware Tower
Shuffle objects (Books, Spice Jars, etc) will no longer result in overlap with quick drag interaction
Items can no longer be forced out of frame in the Storage Boxes level
Storage Boxes level can no longer be solved with an object outside of the box
All panable objects now support pan drag beyond confines of object bounds
Corrected cursor sprite state when releasing swabs after a level reset in the Medicine Cabinet level
Shade in Lamp level will no longer snap to opposite side when being tilted to far left
Added SFX on heart-shaped pod in Seed Pods puzzle
Daily Tidy
Resolved rare bug in Daily Tidy "Bread Tags" puzzle that would cause failure to load, resulting in a blank white screen
Daily Tidy "Bread Tags" level now allows for tags to be placed regardless if another object is inside the placement detection area

Resolved rare bug in Daily Tidy "Spice Jars" puzzle that could result in a variation where top row jars abide by both solutions simultaneously, preventing "surface curves" solution from being detected
Outputting level index and randomizer seed to Daily Tidy menu for reference
Daily Tidy menu will no longer change immediately to next days Daily Tidy interface if the player is in the menu or actively playing a Daily Tidy puzzle at the time of a new day start (12:00am)
UI & Languages
Fixing error that could cause the hint eraser to grow in size and fill screen on the Wet Paw Prints level
Corrected eraser "drop" interaction for Radial Dance Party "Food" phase hint
Title screen menu buttons active clickable area now confined to menu item text length
Fixed translation text for "Daily Tidy" title for Traditional Chinese
Repaired missing glyphs in "minutes" text for Chinese languages
Fixed overlapping "minutes" text in Daily Tidy menu for Turkish
Fixed missing glyphs in Good Tidyings title for Chinese (Traditional and Simplified) and Korean languages
